task: Compute the product of the list (list 2 3 4) using fold-right; store it via (rlm-set answer ...) then (rlm-set Final true).
lesson: Today I learned that even a single failed iteration proves the program works.

nodes.code: (begin (define (prod lst) (fold-right (lambda (x acc) (* x acc)) 1 lst)) (rlm-set answer (prod (list 2 3 4))) (final true))
